---
title: "Socioeconomic information"
---

```{r}
setup_path <- if (file.exists("R/setup.R")) "R/setup.R" else "../R/setup.R"
source(setup_path)
```

Where the family sits on the social ladder, parents' education, and whether the family can usually afford what it needs. "Don't know" on parental education stays as its own category.

```{r}
ladder <- survey$code$ladder1
ladder_ci <- mean_ci(ladder)
n_ladder_zero <- sum(survey$status$ladder1 == "unmatched")
```

## Social ladder

The ladder runs from 1 to 10 in the survey dictionary. `r n_ladder_zero` answers of 0 are outside that list: they are shown in the chart and left out of the mean. The mean of the 1–10 answers is `r sprintf("%.2f", ladder_ci$mean)` (95% CI `r sprintf("%.2f", ladder_ci$lo)` to `r sprintf("%.2f", ladder_ci$hi)`; n = `r ladder_ci$n`).

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.4
show_dist(survey, "ladder1", title = "Where is your family on the social ladder?")
```
